headline: "Sold 5.6 Trillion Won in Domestic Stocks, Bought 10 Trillion in U.S. Stocks": Retail Investors Shift to U.S. Market
summary: Retail investors sold 5.6 trillion won of domestic stocks and bought 10 trillion won of U.S. stocks while the KOSPI failed to recover the 7,000 level. Net buying was recorded in U.S. shares.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main benchmark index, and retail capital flows between domestic and US equities affect its liquidity and performance.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Net retail selling of domestic stocks has kept the index from recovering the 7,000 level.
